## Merge test (throwaway worktree, now cleaned up)

- **Merge**: clean — no conflicts. Git auto-merged `internal/template/create.go` and `internal/template/manifest.go`.
- **`go build ./...`**: OK
- **`go vet ./...`**: OK
- **`go test ./...`**: OK — 15 packages pass, no failures
